title: Tableland Deals Protocol
tagline: An extension to Tableland that allows the execution of compound operations that require write access from multiple parties
description:
Tableland Deals Protocol is an extension to Tableland that allows the execution of compound operations that require write access from multiple parties.

Parties can draft a "deal" - a list of Tableland SQL operations that will be performed on behalf of certain users. Deals can only be executed if they are signed by all parties.

The Deal Writer Dapp enables in-progress deals to be drafted, signed and shared over IPFS before execution.
